verdicts.claim: A registry of the drop and 9,000 trades replays from nothing to the very same cards, owners and head.
verdicts.saw: 10000 entries (5.7 MB, 633 owners) replayed from nothing: the very same registry

verdicts.claim: At every step of every mesh’s growth, the shares of its fielded cards sum to exactly 1,000,000.
On every set, the mesh with all its departments scores above its first department alone on TEST.
On every set, the mesh’s TEST AUC never falls by more than 0.005 as a department joins.
The registry of about 10,000 entries replays from nothing in at most 300 seconds on the measuring machine.
